race.comment: EXTREME TURBO (7) got the job done on debut at Hamilton in a strong effort, sitting handy and running away to win by 2L. That was 51 days ago, but he's been back to the jumpouts since where he was solid at Mornington and with this shaping similarly, he can repeat the dose. PLEASE ME DO (15) ran over the top to score two back here before a 1.4L defeat over this track and trip. Stanley hops back aboard, replacing the apprentice hoop. Looks to get the favours today and can figure in the finish once again. TITAN'S SPIRIT (17) resumes here with a Crabourne jumpout victory under his belt. He was solid through his last campaighn, putting up a few figures that can win this race. Can resume on a positive note. COLT FORTY FIVE (16) disappointed two back but returned to form over this course and distance last start and gets the blinkers back on today.
